en.headline: Large dog kills two small dogs near YOHO Mall in Yuen Long
en.dek: A roughly 60 kg dog without a leash or muzzle attacked a 17-year-old miniature poodle and a four-year-old bichon frise within about 20 minutes; police and AFCD are seeking the owner.
body: A large dog weighing about 60 kg killed two small dogs in separate attacks near YOHO Mall in Yuen Long on Monday afternoon, police said.

At about 3:06 p.m., a 58-year-old man reported that his 17-year-old brown miniature poodle, weighing about 5 kg, was attacked near a taxi stand outside YOHO Mall 1 while being walked. The owner took the dog to a nearby veterinary clinic, where it was confirmed dead.

About 20 minutes later, a 50-year-old woman reported that her four-year-old white bichon frise, also about 5 kg, was attacked at the nearby Bang Bang Tong Park and died at the scene. Passers-by tried to intervene but could not separate the dogs.

Police said the attacking dog, about 1.5 metres long and one metre high, was wearing a collar but no leash or muzzle. Officers and Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff later secured the animal and took it to the New Territories North Animal Management Centre. Its microchip could not immediately be scanned because of its agitated state, and the owner has not yet been located.

Under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation, large dogs of 20 kg or more must be kept on a lead no longer than two metres in public places or secured in a way that does not endanger the public. Police are investigating.

zh.headline: 元朗YOHO大狗連咬死兩小狗 警尋狗主
zh.dek: 約60公斤大狗在約20分鐘內先後咬死17歲迷你貴婦狗及4歲比熊犬，當時無狗繩及口罩，漁護署已帶走涉事狗隻。
body: 警方表示，今日下午元朗YOHO一帶先後發生兩宗大狗襲擊小狗事件，兩隻小狗均傷重死亡。
約下午3時06分，一名58歲男子報案，指其17歲、重約5公斤的啡色迷你貴婦狗，在YOHO Mall 1停車場小路近的士站放狗時，被一隻大型啡色狗突然衝出襲擊。狗主即時將愛犬送往附近獸醫診所，其後證實不治。
約20分鐘後，一名50歲女子報案，指其4歲、重約5公斤的白色比熊犬在附近棒棒堂公園放狗期間，同樣被大狗咬住頸部，當場倒地死亡。期間有途人嘗試制止但未能成功。
警方指，涉事大狗身長約1.5米、高約1米、重約60公斤，當時只有頸帶，沒有狗繩及口罩。多名警員合力將狗隻控制後，漁護署人員將其帶往新界北動物管理中心。由於狗隻情緒仍處於危險狀態，暫時未能掃描晶片，暫未找到狗主。
根據《危險狗隻規例》，體重達20公斤或以上的大型狗只在公眾地方必須以不超過2米長的狗帶穩妥牽引。警方正調查事件。
